To insure proper structural behavior under both conventional and blast loadings, a minimum amount of flexural reinforcement is required. This quantity of reinforcement ensures that the moment capacity of the reinforced section is greater than that corresponding to the plain concrete section computed from its modulus of rupture.Failure of a plain concrete section is quite sudden. Also, this minimum reinforcement prevents excessive cracking and deformations under conventional loadings.
